title: Contain failures and establish a baseline
scope: Map all reads and writers, including undocumented routes and report references.
Apply bounded containment fixes to the legacy compatibility adapter without assigning new access.
Capture business incident and onboarding baseline with source and observation window.
excluded: Automatic resolution of ambiguous existing access
invariants: Separate static evidence, reported symptom, and hypothesis.
An absent organization is 404, not an unchecked list index.
A null embedded legacy list is an explicit empty/reviewable state.
No unscoped writer may run during a target tenant pilot.

acceptance.given: A legacy organization has a null embedded resource list
acceptance.then: the organization metadata renders with a clear empty or review state; no uncontrolled exception

acceptance.given: A legacy create request conflicts with an existing approval entry
acceptance.when: the request is rejected before insertion
acceptance.then: no organization or user mutation occurs; record the actual conflict without claiming corruption
acceptance.evidence: transaction snapshot comparison and diagnosis review

acceptance.given: Search has a known literal term and language
acceptance.then: the term participates in the parameterized filter and unrelated rows are excluded

acceptance.given: A scoped legacy access change fails after the first write
acceptance.then: neither partial access deletion nor unrelated organization change persists
acceptance.evidence: database fault injection and write inventory

acceptance.given: Runtime authorization paths are absent from the inspected slice
acceptance.then: the missing consumer and identity owners are recorded; no production effective-access parity claim is made
acceptance.evidence: reviewed evidence register and question ownership
